build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions using pip install from source
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension for gtn modules like _graph _autograd _utils _rand _creations _functions _parallel
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild command to compile gtn native extensions with cmake version 3.5.1 or higher
review_cmakebuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that configures cmake args and builds gtn extensions on non-Windows platforms
review_cmakextension_class: review the CMakeExtension class that creates setuptools extensions without Python source files
